verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI advertises automated PR review with contextual feedback (gh-10), issue triage (gh-11), and can query pull requests via CLI (gh-4), and one community report confirms its code review caught bugs missed by reviewers (comm-20). However, there's no evidence of integrated 'run checks/tests' functionality beyond review comments, and broader reliability concerns (agentic loops, ignoring context files) raise caveats about trusting it for pre-merge safety.
